Include conf.d/*.conf
Host local-dev.invalid
  HostName local.invalid
  User synthetic-user

Include shared/build.conf
Host work-dev.invalid work-alt.invalid
  HostName work.invalid
  User ignored-user
  Port 2222
  IdentityFile /synthetic/not-a-real-key
  ProxyJump synthetic-jump.invalid

Host personal-dev.invalid
  HostName personal.invalid
Host *.invalid !excluded.invalid
  User ignored-pattern-user
